title: Legal Researcher Registration
description: Complete registration form for legal researchers joining the ICJ network.

steps.stepDescription: Your current institutional affiliation and research focus.

fields.name: current_institution
fields.label: Current Institution / Organisation
fields.helpText: Name of the university, research institute, or organisation you are currently associated with.

fields.name: designation
fields.label: Designation / Role
fields.helpText: Your current designation or role at the institution.

fields.name: experience_years
fields.label: Years of Research Experience
fields.helpText: Total years of legal research experience.

fields.name: research_focus
fields.label: Research Focus Areas
fields.helpText: Select all areas where you have substantive research experience.

fields.name: university
fields.label: University / Institution
fields.helpText: Name of the university or institution that awarded your degree.

fields.name: passing_year
fields.label: Year of Passing
fields.helpText: Year in which you passed your highest degree.

steps.stepDescription: Your publications, identifiers, and language capabilities.

fields.name: publications
fields.label: Key Publications (list titles)
fields.placeholder: List titles of your key publications, one per line...
fields.helpText: Mention titles of significant journal articles, books, or reports you have authored or co-authored (optional).

fields.name: orcid_id
fields.label: ORCID ID (if available)
fields.helpText: Your ORCID iD, if you have one. Format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

fields.name: languages
fields.label: Working Languages
fields.helpText: Languages in which you can conduct or review legal research.

steps.stepDescription: Upload required documents to verify your credentials.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Passport-size Photograph
fields.helpText: Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPG or PNG, max 2 MB).

fields.name: cv_document
fields.label: Curriculum Vitae (CV)
fields.helpText: Upload your academic/professional CV (PDF, max 5 MB).

fields.name: identity_proof
fields.label: Identity Proof
fields.helpText: Upload a government-issued identity document (PDF, JPG or PNG, max 5 MB).
